title: Home practical guide and safety card: opening a soaked bean
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Dissolving, separating and plants (Do All Solids Dissolve? and Allotment)
source: Written for science/y5 lesson 36 (Home practical guide and safety card: opening a soaked bean (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 36: Inside a seed and how plants grow. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

equipment: Two dried broad beans or butter beans
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Soak the beans in water overnight
Next day, rub the skin gently until it slips off (the seed coat)
Open the bean carefully into its two halves with your fingers
Find the tiny root and shoot (the embryo)
Draw and label the seed coat, food store and embryo

questions.q: The baby plant inside a seed is the...
Big question: where does a bean get its energy in the dark?
questions.a: From its food store inside the seed.
